annotations.title: Get the site's uploader for a line

description: The printdash.io page whose own uploader takes artwork for this line: checkout for a cart line, the quote page for a saved quote's line, the order page for an order job. It opens signed in in the browser the customer connected with. Use it when the customer has the file but the chat cannot send it. Refused when the line's artwork can no longer change. Needs a signed-in Printdash account: called without one, the connection asks the customer to sign in on printdash.io.

design.description: Which design (1 to N) on a job with several designs. Omit on a one-design job.

kind.description: cart_line (line_id from get_cart), quote_line (line_id from get_quote) or order_item (item_id from get_order).

side.description: front (default) or back, on a double-sided job.

name: get_artwork_uploader_link
title: Get the site's uploader for a line
